title: 10. Les philosophes, nouveaux experts de l'IA
gist: Ten years ago students were told to learn to code; now it's programmers who worry about AI taking their jobs, while philosophy graduates have lower unemployment and are being snapped up by AI labs. Companies use philosophical training — the Socratic method, humility about what a model doesn't know — to make AI less sycophantic and overconfident, and write “constitutions” of moral rules (like Anthropic's for Claude) drawing on two rival ethical frameworks: strict rules versus weighing consequences. Hard questions remain unresolved, so there's no shortage of work for philosophers of AI.

body.fr: On dit souvent qu'il {{faut|is necessary, must}} apprendre à coder pour trouver un emploi facilement.

bd.meaning: People often say you have to learn to code to find a job easily.
chunks: people often say (on = people/you/we in general)
that you have to / it's necessary to
to find a job easily (pour + plain verb = 'in order to')
bd.key: il faut + plain verb = “you have to / it's necessary to.” il faut never changes form — it's always “il faut,” whoever is being told.

body.fr: Mais aujourd'hui, {{ce sont|it's — plural}} les programmeurs qui ont peur de perdre leur travail à cause de l'IA.

bd.meaning: But today, it's the programmers who are afraid of losing their jobs because of AI.
chunks: it's the programmers (ce sont = plural version of c'est)
who are afraid of losing (avoir peur de = to be afraid of)
leur travail à cause de l'IA
bd.key: “ce sont” = the plural of “c'est.” Use it when what follows is plural: ce sont les programmeurs = “it's the programmers.”

body.fr: Une étude montre une chose {{surprenante|surprising}}.

bd.meaning: A study shows something surprising.
chunks: a surprising thing (surprenante after the noun, agreeing feminine)
bd.key: Adjective after the noun, agreeing with it: chose is feminine, so surprenant becomes surprenante.

body.fr: Les {{diplômés en philosophie|philosophy graduates}} trouvent un emploi plus facilement que les diplômés en informatique.

bd.meaning: Philosophy graduates find a job more easily than computer science graduates.
bd.key: plus + adverb + que = “more ___ than.” Same comparison shape you use with adjectives, here applied to facilement (easily).

body.fr: Beaucoup d'entreprises d'IA {{embauchent|hire}} maintenant des philosophes.

bd.meaning: Many AI companies now hire philosophers.
bd.key: -ent ending = plural subject. embauchent tells you the subject (les entreprises) is plural, even though you don't hear the ending.

body.fr: Des étudiants {{reçoivent|receive}} une offre d'emploi avant même de finir leurs études.

bd.meaning: Students receive a job offer before they've even finished their studies.
chunks: before even finishing (avant de + plain verb)
bd.key: avant de + plain verb = “before ___ing.” Like pour, the verb after avant de stays plain: avant de finir = “before finishing.”

body.fr: Les IA disent souvent oui à tout, pour {{plaire|please}} aux utilisateurs.

bd.meaning: AIs often say yes to everything, to please users.
chunks: Les IA disent souvent oui à tout
AIs often say yes to everything
bd.key: pour + plain verb, again. pour plaire = “to please” — the same “in order to” shape from earlier stories.

body.fr: La méthode de Socrate, un {{philosophe grec|Greek philosopher}}, apprend à un modèle à poser des questions et à chercher la vérité.

bd.meaning: Socrates's method, a Greek philosopher, teaches a model to ask questions and seek the truth.
chunks: a Greek philosopher (grec after the noun)
apprend à un modèle à poser des questions
teaches a model to ask questions (apprendre à qqn à + verb)
bd.key: apprendre à qqn à + plain verb = “to teach someone to ___.” Two à's in a row: one for the person, one before the verb.

body.fr: Une autre idée de Socrate dit qu'il faut savoir {{qu'on ne sait pas tout|that we don't know everything}}.

bd.meaning: Another idea of Socrates says you have to know that you don't know everything.
chunks: Une autre idée de Socrate dit
that we don't know everything (ne...pas around sait)
bd.key: ne … pas around “sait”: on ne sait pas tout = “we don't know everything” — the familiar negation sandwich, one more time.

body.fr: Cette {{humilité|humility}} aide l'IA à être moins sûre d'elle et à inventer moins de fausses informations.

bd.meaning: This humility helps AI be less overconfident and invent less false information.
chunks: Cette humilité aide l'IA à être
this humility helps AI be (aider qqn à + verb)
less sure of itself / less overconfident
false information (fausses before the noun here)
bd.key: aider qqn à + plain verb = “help someone (to) ___.” aide l'IA à être = “helps AI (to) be.”

body.fr: Certaines entreprises écrivent une « {{constitution|constitution}} » pour leur IA.

bd.meaning: Some companies write a 'constitution' for their AI.
bd.key: “certaines” = “some” (feminine). It agrees with the noun it introduces — here entreprises, feminine plural.

body.fr: C'est une longue {{liste de règles morales|list of moral rules}}.

bd.meaning: It's a long list of moral rules.
chunks: a long list (longue before the noun)
of moral rules (morales after, agreeing feminine plural)
bd.key: Some adjectives go before, some after. longue (long) comes before the noun, but morales (moral) comes after — most descriptive adjectives follow this second pattern.

body.fr: Anthropic, qui a créé le chatbot Claude, {{a écrit|wrote}} une constitution de 78 pages avec des idées de plusieurs philosophes.

bd.meaning: Anthropic, which created the chatbot Claude, wrote a 78-page constitution with ideas from several philosophers.
chunks: Anthropic, qui a créé le chatbot Claude
Anthropic, which created the chatbot Claude
wrote (a + écrit = past form of écrire)
avec des idées de plusieurs philosophes
bd.key: Past = avoir + past participle, again. a écrit = “wrote” — same pattern as a inventé from an earlier story.

body.fr: Il {{existe|exists — there are}} deux grandes façons de penser la morale.

bd.meaning: There are two big ways of thinking about morality.
chunks: there exist(s) / there are (a formal cousin of 'il y a')
two big ways (grandes before the noun)
bd.key: “Il existe” = another way to say “there is/are.” Slightly more formal than il y a, but works the same way.

body.fr: La première dit que certaines actions sont {{toujours interdites|always forbidden}}, comme mentir.

bd.meaning: The first says that certain actions are always forbidden, like lying.
chunks: like lying (plain verb used as a noun)
bd.key: A plain verb can act like a noun. mentir here means “lying” — French often uses the plain verb where English adds “-ing.”

body.fr: La deuxième regarde seulement les {{conséquences|consequences}} avant de choisir une action.

bd.meaning: The second only looks at the consequences before choosing an action.
bd.key: avant de + plain verb, once more. avant de choisir = “before choosing” — same shape as avant de finir earlier.

body.fr: Les {{voitures autonomes|self-driving cars}} utilisent cette deuxième idée pour décider quoi faire avant un accident.

bd.meaning: Self-driving cars use this second idea to decide what to do before an accident.
chunks: to decide what to do (pour + plain verb)
bd.key: pour + plain verb, back again. pour décider = “to decide” — this “in order to” shape is everywhere once you notice it.

body.fr: Mais des questions {{difficiles|difficult}} restent sans réponse.

bd.meaning: But difficult questions remain unanswered.
chunks: but difficult questions (difficiles after the noun)
without an answer (sans = without, no article after it)
bd.key: “sans” drops the article, just like sans avocat earlier: sans réponse = “without an answer,” not “without a answer.”

body.fr: {{Est-ce que|is it that — question marker}} l'IA doit aussi protéger les animaux et la nature ?

bd.meaning: Should AI also protect animals and nature?
chunks: question marker — turns a statement into a yes/no question
AI must/should also protect (devoir + plain verb)
bd.key: Est-ce que + statement = a yes/no question. Drop it in front of any sentence — l'IA doit protéger… becomes a question, word order unchanged.

body.fr: Une chose est {{sûre|certain, sure}} : les philosophes ont beaucoup de travail avec l'intelligence artificielle.

bd.meaning: One thing is certain: philosophers have plenty of work with artificial intelligence.
bd.key: “avoir beaucoup de ___” = “to have a lot of ___.” Simple and everyday — swap in any noun after beaucoup de.

grammar.en: il faut + plain verb = “you have to / it's necessary to.” A fixed, unchanging phrase — no matter who's being told, it's always il faut.

grammar.fr: avant de finir / avant de choisir
grammar.en: avant de + plain verb = “before ___ing.” The verb after avant de stays plain, just like after pour.
avoir + past participle = the past (passé composé). a écrit = “wrote” — your “past = avoir/être + verb” key, showing up again.

quiz.q: Pourquoi Anthropic a-t-il écrit une « constitution » pour Claude ?
quiz.a: Pour donner à l'IA des règles morales claires, basées sur les idées de plusieurs philosophes. (To give the AI clear moral rules, based on the ideas of several philosophers.)

flag: Heavy compression: the original names many philosophers and executives (Floridi, Noller, Gabriel, Powers, Rossi, Bostrom, Heck, Yampolskiy) and specific products (IBM's Granite, Inflection's Pi, Waymo, Google DeepMind) — I dropped all of them to keep the story to two ideas (the Socratic method, AI constitutions) and two ethical frameworks (strict rules vs. weighing consequences). The 7%/5.1% unemployment figures and the 78-page Claude constitution are accurate to the article; everything else is simplified. A native speaker might say philosophie morale rather than just la morale in one sentence, and the real French terms déontologie / conséquentialisme exist — I avoided them here as too technical for A1.
